root_cause: Frame conversion, resize and canvas allocation preceded host geometry checks; PNG encoding was unbounded until the host read the completed file. Source, resized and canvas images and the output buffer lacked deterministic closure on normal and exceptional paths.
changes: Check each prospective sheet against 8192-side and 16000000-pixel limits before the next conversion/resize and check the final canvas before allocation
Reject an encoder write beyond 8MiB before retaining it or creating the output file
Close each resized source before converting the next frame; close retained images, canvas and buffer on success or Python failure
Continue remaining image closures after a close failure and preserve exception context
Map generation budget rejection to media_sheet_invalid; keep controlled selection, timestamps, labels and two-column layout
